adopt: Mint a Space on this device and open it in the browser -- a page, your files, your companion.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
The web stopped being a place humans make things in and became feeds that are made at them, and the first thing AI did there was flood it with bots. There is no surface where a person keeps a page, a companion that works for them, and a community they can find on purpose -- with the agent as a tool, never a peer.

synopsis: A place, not a page: every human gets a Space -- a hand-made page, files and a companion agent that is theirs -- and Spaces link to Spaces. Early-2000s internet (Neocities, Newgrounds, Neopets, RuneScape) with local-first AI underneath.
